title: Suicide note found after jump from plane
article: The RCMP say they found a suicide note from a prisoner who jumped to his death from a float plane flying 1,600 metres above the northern B.C. coast.
Masset RCMP Sergeant Steve Berney says Donald Bigg was arrested Wednesday morning on charges of sexual assault with a weapon.
A helicopter, two Coast Guard boats and two fishing vessels searched the cold waters for several hours yesterday before calling off the search for Mr. Bigg's body.
